'''Politics and elections'''
*[[June 2023 Greek legislative election]]
**[[Greeks]] head to the polls for the second time this year to elect the 300 members of the [[Hellenic Parliament]]. [https://apnews.com/article/greece-elections-prime-minister-parliament-e87e05317a208f66d877244eba5b947c (AP)]
**[[New Democracy (Greece)|New Democracy]] leader [[Kyriakos Mitsotakis]] regains an absolute majority of 158 seats and is expected to be sworn in as [[Prime Minister of Greece|Prime Minister]] for a second term after previously handing his premiership to [[Ioannis Sarmas]] last month. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-65997486 (BBC News)]
*[[2023 Guatemalan general election]]
**[[Guatemalans]] head to the polls to elect officials in the [[President of Guatemala|presidential]], [[Congress of the Republic of Guatemala|congressional]], [[Central American Parliament]], and other local elections. Presidential candidates [[Sandra Torres]] and [[Bernardo Arévalo]] will face a run-off vote on 20 August. [https://manilastandard.net/news/world-news/314343077/dictators-daughter-ex-first-lady-un-diplomat-vie-to-lead-guatemala.html (AFP via ''Manila Standard'')] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/jun/26/guatemala-presidential-election-bernardo-arevalo-corruption-sandra-torres (''The Guardian'')]
